id.description: Stable slug; primary registry key; immutable once published.

description.description: DUAL-PURPOSE: (1) human-readable one-line summary shown in UIs and catalogs; (2) LLM invocation guidance — write as 'Use this when X' or 'Handles Y so the host doesn't have to'. Do NOT use marketing copy. Long-form prose belongs in README/SKILL.md (P3). This field is the primary signal a catalog or orchestrating agent uses to decide whether to invoke this extension.

host.description: semver range of supported host versions, e.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'.

entrypoint.description: Resolved at install. Required for behavioral types; omitted for prompt (host convention: prompt.md).

keywords.description: Discovery tags for catalog search and LLM tool-selection. Short, lowercase, hyphenated preferred (e.g. 'memory', 'code-review'). Optional — absent extensions are not penalized in P2; required enforcement is deferred to P5/P6 strict mode.

author.description: Extension author. String form ('Name <email>') or structured object with name, optional email and url.

homepage.description: URL of the extension's documentation or project home page.

requires.description: Static capability requirements checked against configured provider at install time.

order.description: Hook execution order for the bound lifecycle event (ascending). Only meaningful when type=='hook'. Ties broken by id lexicographic. See Gap 2.

dependencies.description: Runtime dependencies: extension ids + semver ranges this extension requires to be installed. Enforced at install time (Gap F2): the installer must verify each declared dependency is present and satisfies the declared version range before activating this extension.

tags.description: Coarse-grained classification labels (e.g. 'productivity', 'coding'). Complements keywords. Optional.

repository.description: URL of the extension's source repository (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo).

checksum.description: Populated by CI at publish time; verified on install.

runtime.description: Author-declared runtime contract. 'node' = TS/Node, can call the provider abstraction. 'stdio-any' = language-agnostic stdio process; MUST NOT declare provider requires. Absent => 'node' (back-compat: all v1 extensions are Node).

lifecycle.description: Host-owned process supervision for long-running extensions. Optional; absent => v1 request/response behavior (no daemon). Only meaningful for type in {mcp-server, agent}.

background.description: If true the host keeps the process alive across calls (supervised) instead of lazy per-call spawn.

singleton.description: At most one host-supervised instance per scope key. Host holds the lock — replaces the extension's own OS advisory lock.

health.description: How the host probes liveness. Absent => process-alive only.

endpoint.description: Socket path or command; required when type in {socket, command}.

stop_timeout_ms.description: Grace period on SIGTERM before SIGKILL.

members.description: Bundle members. Required iff type=='bundle'. Each is an independently-published extension pinned by semver range. 'dependencies' and 'members' are orthogonal: dependencies is a runtime/keystone relation; members is a packaging relation.

events.description: P2 — HOOK self-description. Lifecycle events this hook binds to. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent); flipped to required in P3. Each entry must be a known host lifecycle event name. Closed enum prevents binding to non-existent events. Seeded from current usage: audit-hook binds PreToolUse; memory-flush binds SessionEnd + ScopePromotionProposed.

invocation.description: P2 — AGENT and COMMAND self-description. Declares the invocation protocol and handler interface so a host can discover capability without executing code. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent); flipped to required in P3. Resolves the observed divergence: agent tools[]+execute vs organizeItems(); command run(input) vs runCli(argv).

protocol.description: Transport by which the host calls this extension. 'function-export' = host imports the entrypoint module and calls an exported function (most Node extensions). 'stdio' = the host spawns a subprocess and communicates over stdin/stdout. 'ipc' = Node IPC channel. 'http' = HTTP endpoint.

handler.description: The exported function or method name the host calls. For protocol='function-export' this is the exact export name (e.g. 'run', 'execute', 'handler', 'organizeItems'). This resolves the run/runCli and tools[]/organizeItems divergence.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 subset) describing the input passed to the handler. For agents: the task descriptor shape. For commands: the argv/input shape. OPTIONAL — absent means untyped input (legacy).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 subset) describing the value returned by the handler. OPTIONAL — absent means untyped output (legacy).

tools.description: P2 — MCP-SERVER self-description. Machine-readable tool descriptors at rest in the manifest, mirroring the tools the server advertises at runtime via tools/list. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent); flipped to required in P3. Enables static capability discovery without spawning the server.

name.description: Tool name as returned by tools/list. Must be stable (clients cache by name).

description.description: Human- and LLM-readable description. Dual-purpose: shown in UIs and used by the orchestrator to decide whether to invoke the tool. Write as 'Use this when X' or 'Fetches Y from Z'.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input. Mirrors the inputSchema field in the MCP tools/list response. OPTIONAL — absent means the tool accepts any input.

parameters.description: P2 — PROMPT self-description. Declares the template parameters this prompt requires. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent); flipped to required in P3. Enables a host to validate parameter completeness before rendering without parsing prompt.md.

name.description: Parameter name as used in the template body (e.g. 'name' for {{name}}).

type.description: Parameter value type. Defaults to 'string' if absent.

required.description: Whether this parameter must be supplied by the caller. Defaults to true.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this parameter controls.

template_engine.description: P2 — PROMPT self-description. Declares the substitution engine the prompt.md template requires so the host can render it without guessing. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent for prompt type); flipped to required in P3. 'simple' = {{key}} literal replacement only.

run_interface.description: P2 — SKILL self-description. Declares the `run` function's input and output schema. OPTIONAL-FIRST in P2 (warn when absent); flipped to required in P3. Enables orchestrators to validate skill invocation at rest without loading the module.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 subset) describing the SkillInput shape passed to run(). OPTIONAL — absent means untyped.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 subset) describing the SkillOutput shape returned by run(). OPTIONAL — absent means untyped.

config_schema.description: PB — JSON Schema (draft-07 subset) for the scope-resolved config block supplied to this extension at install time. The installer validates the resolved config against this schema before activation; a config that violates the schema fails validation (closes Gap F3). OPTIONAL — absent means the extension accepts any config object (same as before PB). ENFORCEMENT NOTE for P4/P5: the permission bounds declared in 'permissions' (e.g. fs.paths) must also be enforced at runtime (sandbox db_path to declared paths — Gap F5); this field ships the DECLARATION; the host wires the enforcement.

permissions.description: PB — Resource/permission declaration. Declares the fs, network, and socket resources this extension may access. OPTIONAL — absent means no declared resource bounds (legacy behaviour preserved). ENFORCEMENT NOTE for P4/P5: the host runtime must honour these declared bounds (sandboxing, policy checks — Gaps F5/A6); this phase ships the DECLARATION; the host wires the enforcement. Do NOT leave this unimplemented once declared — coordinate with P4/P5.

fs.description: Filesystem access declarations. Absent => no declared fs access.

read.description: Glob patterns or absolute paths the extension may read. Use '~/' prefix for home-relative paths.

write.description: Glob patterns or absolute paths the extension may write/create/delete.

network.description: Network access declarations. Absent => no declared network access.

outbound.description: Hostnames or URL prefixes the extension may connect to (e.g. 'api.openai.com', 'https://api.anthropic.com/').

socket.description: Unix domain socket access declarations. Absent => no declared socket access.

paths.description: Unix domain socket paths the extension may bind or connect to (e.g. '~/.memory/memoryd.sock').
